text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Symboli Kris S—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Symboli Kris S was gazing,
I saw a claw crane machine filled with
stuffed plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...An Umamusume—is the model.
Everyone is happy—that they got one.
choice_data_list: Yeah, looks like they're pretty popular.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Popularity...
It's tied to... bringing hype to the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Symboli Kris S wants to know more about the plushies.
In that case—
choice_data_list: I'll give it a try and see if I can get it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
